title: New York Blocks T-Mobile Low-Income Internet Data Caps
excerpt: New York is requiring T-Mobile to halt speed throttling and data caps on home internet plans offered through the Affordable Broadband Act.
body_html:
New York state authorities are requiring T-Mobile to eliminate data caps and speed throttling on home internet services provided through the Affordable Broadband Act.

Under the intervention, the company must stop restricting data usage for low-income plans that were previously subject to slowed speeds after reaching certain thresholds.
